"""Migrated Meridian CRM case_lifecycle workflow."""

from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

Record = dict[str, Any]
Guard = Callable[[Record], bool]
Action = tuple[str, str, Any]
Transition = tuple[str, str, str, Guard | None, tuple[Action, ...]]


def _value(record: Record, field: str) -> Any:
    """Read a field using the legacy missing-value convention."""
    return record.get(field, "")


def _non_empty(record: Record, field: str) -> bool:
    return _value(record, field) != ""


def _not_equal(record: Record, field: str, literal: str) -> bool:
    return _value(record, field) != literal


def _nvl(field: str, default: str) -> Callable[[Record], Any]:
    def evaluate(record: Record) -> Any:
        value = _value(record, field)
        return default if value == "" else value

    return evaluate


_TRANSITIONS: tuple[Transition, ...] = (
    (
        "N",
        "A",
        "assign",
        lambda record: _non_empty(record, "OWNER_UID"),
        (("audit", "CASE_ASSIGN", None),),
    ),
    (
        "N",
        "A",
        "auto_escalate",
        None,
        (
            ("set", "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
            ("set_expr", "SEV_CD", _nvl("SEV_CD", "3")),
            ("audit", "CASE_ESC", None),
            ("notify", "escalation", None),
        ),
    ),
    (
        "A",
        "A",
        "auto_escalate",
        lambda record: _not_equal(record, "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
        (
            ("set", "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
            ("audit", "CASE_ESC", None),
            ("notify", "escalation", None),
        ),
    ),
    (
        "A",
        "P",
        "await_customer",
        None,
        (("audit", "CASE_PEND", None),),
    ),
    (
        "P",
        "A",
        "customer_reply",
        None,
        (),
    ),
    (
        "A",
        "R",
        "resolve",
        lambda record: _not_equal(record, "RES_DT", "00000000"),
        (("audit", "CASE_RES", None),),
    ),
    (
        "R",
        "X",
        "close",
        None,
        (("audit", "CASE_CLOSE", None),),
    ),
    (
        "R",
        "A",
        "reopen",
        None,
        (
            ("set", "RES_DT", "00000000"),
            ("audit", "CASE_REOPEN", None),
        ),
    ),
)


def fire(state: str, event: str, record: dict) -> dict:
    """Dispatch an explicit event through the case_lifecycle workflow."""
    result_record = dict(record)

    for source, target, transition_event, guard, actions in _TRANSITIONS:
        if source != state or transition_event != event:
            continue
        if guard is not None and not guard(result_record):
            continue

        audits: list[str] = []
        notifies: list[str] = []

        for action_type, name, value in actions:
            if action_type == "set":
                result_record[name] = value
            elif action_type == "set_expr":
                result_record[name] = value(result_record)
            elif action_type == "audit":
                audits.append(name)
            elif action_type == "notify":
                notifies.append(name)

        return {
            "state": target,
            "record": result_record,
            "audits": audits,
            "notifies": notifies,
            "matched": True,
        }

    return {
        "state": state,
        "record": result_record,
        "audits": ["WF_NOMATCH"],
        "notifies": [],
        "matched": False,
    }
